“清心草和驱邪花，我有带呀！”

范梦雪眼睛一亮，连忙从自己的行李箱里翻出两个小小的药包，递到胡九郎面前，得意道：

“师兄你看，这就是清心草和驱邪花，都是我下山前，师父让我带上的，说或许能派上用场，没想到真的能用得上。”

胡九郎接过药包，打开一看，只见清心草翠绿欲滴，散发着淡淡的清香，驱邪花则是淡紫色，花瓣上还带着晶莹的露珠，显然是刚采摘不久，灵气十足。他心中一暖，看来师伯早就预料到这一切，提前给范梦雪准备好了药材。

“太好了，有了这两样，就省了不少麻烦。现在就差玄阴石了，玄阴石产自阴寒之地，质地坚硬，能吸收阴邪之气，又能承载正气，在魔都这种繁华之地，很难找到，只能去黑市碰碰运气。”

就在这时，卦铺的门被推开，杨童带着苏笑笑走了进来，身后还跟着林佳，手里拿着一个文件袋。苏笑笑脸色有些苍白，眼神里带着几分恐惧和不安，显然已经知道了自己身上印记的事情。

杨童走进来，将苏笑笑扶到椅子上坐下。

“苏笑笑已经知道了影踪印的事情，她愿意配合我们，解除印记。这是冷欣的审讯记录和现场检测报告，都在这里了。”

胡九郎接过文件袋，打开一看，里面详细记录了冷欣的供述：冷欣与陆明是情侣，但是陆明从一开始就是别有用心，目的就是她身上的蛊鼎，陆明始乱终弃，偷走蛊鼎，冷欣一路追杀，直到桃源古镇，陆明似乎早就跟别人取得联系，不确定陆明要找的人是不是夏未来，反正夏未来带走了陆明。

检测报告上则显示，冷欣身上的邪异之气，与苏笑笑身上的影踪印气息同源，都带着一股诡异的阴冷之力，不像是凡间的邪祟，更像是来自玄门诡道的秘术，而且这种气息，与千年前消失的“影阁”秘术，有几分相似。

“影阁？我曾在师父的古籍中看到过记载，影阁是千年前的一个玄门邪派，擅长使用阴邪秘术，专门掠夺他人的灵气和异能，后来因为作恶多端，被各大玄门联手围剿，从此销声匿迹，没想到如今居然又出现了。”

范梦雪也皱起眉头，说道：

“师兄，影阁的秘术都极其阴邪，影踪印就是他们的独门秘术之一，而且他们擅长布局，心思缜密，桃源古镇的大阵，说不定就是影阁的人布置的，夏未来，或许就是影阁的人。”

胡九郎问道：

“夏未来的身份可调查清楚了？”

杨童叹息一声。

“还没有，如果真的是影阁，那事情就麻烦了。千年前，影阁就能与各大玄门抗衡，如今重现江湖，恐怕会掀起一场血雨腥风，失踪的异能者，说不定就是被他们掳走，用来修炼邪术的。”

苏笑笑坐在一旁，听得浑身发抖，声音带着几分哽咽。

“我……我我虽然天天跟死尸打交道，但是我可不想死，胡先生，你一定要救救我。”

胡九郎看着苏笑笑楚楚可怜的模样，说道：

"I've brought the pure heart grass and exorcism flower!"

Fan Mengxue's eyes lit up, and she quickly took out two small medicine bags from her suitcase, handed them to Hu Jiulang, and said proudly:

"Senior brother, look, these are the Qingxincao and the Exorcist Flower. Before I went down the mountain, my master asked me to bring them with me. He said they might be useful, but I didn't expect they would actually come in handy."

Hu Jiulang took the medicine bag and opened it. He saw that the Qingxin grass was emerald green and exuded a faint fragrance, while the exorcism flower was lavender with crystal dewdrops on its petals. It was obvious that it had just been picked not long ago and was full of aura.He felt warm in his heart. It seemed that his uncle had anticipated all this and had prepared medicinal materials for Fan Mengxue in advance.

"Great, with these two things, a lot of trouble is saved. The only thing missing now is Xuanyin Stone. Xuanyin Stone is produced in a cold and cold place. It has a hard texture and can absorb evil spirits and carry righteous energy. It is difficult to find in a prosperous place like the Demon City. You can only try your luck on the black market."

At this moment, the door of Gua Pu was pushed open, and Yang Tong walked in with Su Xiaoxiao, followed by Lin Jia, holding a document bag in his hand.Su Xiaoxiao's face was a little pale, and there was a bit of fear and uneasiness in her eyes. It was obvious that she already knew about the mark on her body.

Yang Tong walked in and helped Su Xiaoxiao to a chair and sat down.

"Su Xiaoxiao already knows about the shadow trace seal, and she is willing to cooperate with us to remove the mark. This is Leng Xin's interrogation record and on-site test report. They are all here."

Hu Jiulang took the document bag and opened it. It contained a detailed record of Leng Xin's confession: Leng Xin and Lu Ming were lovers, but Lu Ming had an ulterior motive from the beginning, and the purpose was the Gu Cauldron on her body.

The test report showed that the evil aura on Leng Xin's body was from the same source as the shadow trace aura on Su Xiaoxiao's body. They both carried a strange and cold power. It was not like evil spirits in the world, but more like a secret technique from the Xuanmen. Moreover, this aura was somewhat similar to the secret technique of the "Shadow Pavilion" that disappeared thousands of years ago.

"Shadow Pavilion? I have seen records in Master's ancient books. Shadow Pavilion was a Xuanmen evil sect thousands of years ago. It was good at using evil secret techniques and specialized in plundering other people's spiritual energy and supernatural powers. Later, because of its many evil deeds, it was jointly surrounded and suppressed by the major Xuanmen. It has disappeared since then. I didn't expect it to reappear now."

Fan Mengxue also frowned and said:

"Senior brother, the secret arts of Shadow Pavilion are extremely sinister. Shadow Trace Seal is one of their unique secret arts. Moreover, they are good at layout and meticulous. The formation in Taoyuan Ancient Town may have been arranged by people from Shadow Pavilion. Xia Laiwei may be from Shadow Pavilion."

Hu Jiulang asked:

"Has Xia Future's identity been investigated clearly?"

Yang Tong sighed.

"Not yet. If it is really the Shadow Pavilion, then things will be in trouble. Thousands of years ago, the Shadow Pavilion was able to compete with the major sects. Now that it has reappeared, I am afraid it will cause a bloody storm. The missing superpowers may have been kidnapped by them and used to practice evil arts."

Su Xiaoxiao sat aside, trembling all over, her voice a little choked.

"I...I deal with dead bodies every day, but I don't want to die. Mr. Hu, you must save me."

Hu Jiulang looked at Su Xiaoxiao's pitiful appearance and said:
